messages:
jordan: Heads up — saw a sharp p95/p99 latency regression after we pushed int8 calibration profile to prod for redwood-v2-13b (eu-west1). p50 unchanged but p95 ~2x and p99 ~3x. Customers complaining about timeouts.

sam-oncall: Can you share sample request IDs and the quant profile name? Any recent batching/infra changes?

jordan: sample request ids: rq_8a1f2c, rq_8a1f2d, rq_8a1f33. We rolled int8 profile 'int8.default.v2' at ~2390012200. No infra deploys at that time. Typical requests are long-context chat (seq len ~1024) with max_tokens 512, batch size usually 1.

maya-ml: Quick hypothesis — int8.default.v2 has a more aggressive kernel path & smaller KV cache alignment; for long sequences that can increase KV/cache misses and first-token latency. Also saw higher CPU on the host during those windows in staging when we tested.

jordan: logs snippet from one of the requests:
```
[2026-03-16T16:34:12Z] request_id=rq_8a1f2c model=redwood-v2-13b quant=int8.default.v2 seq_in=1024 tokens_out=480 latency_total_ms=1420 latency_first_token_ms=820
[2026-03-16T16:34:12Z] cache_miss=true kv_cache_hit=false kernel_path=quant_int8_v2
```

sam-oncall: Does the console show queueing or higher inflight per-worker? Link?

support-bot: Alert posted: https://console.redwood.ai/alerts/alerts/ALRT-7821 (p99 latency spike — int8 rollout)

jordan: Console: per-worker inflight up 2x, worker CPU jumped to ~85%, GPU utilization similar but tail latency skewed.

maya-ml: Immediate mitigations to try:
- Roll back to int8.default.v1 for affected routes (less aggressive quantization), or
- Enable fallback-to-fp16 for the model so we keep int8 but fallback on hot paths, or
- Re-run calibration with a larger/diverse calibration dataset that includes long-context prompts.

commands I used in staging:
```bash
# rollback quant profile
redwood models update --model redwood-v2-13b --quant-profile int8.default.v1 --region eu-west1
# enable fp16 fallback
redwood models update --model redwood-v2-13b --config '{"quant":{"enable_fp16_fallback":true}}' --region eu-west1
# run calibration job
run_calibration --model redwood-v2-13b --quant int8 --dataset /calib/long_context_2026-03-15.jsonl --out /calib/output_v3
```

tom-sre: For immediate customer impact we should pin latency-sensitive routes to fp16 (or rollback). Also change routing policy to prefer fp16 variant when p95 exceeds threshold. I'll open a short-lived rollback runbook.

ryan-qa: Note on quality — we also saw a small degradation on very long generations with v2 int8 in staging: hallucination rate up on a handful of prompts. Example (truncated):
- fp16: "Answer: The API returns 200 and the payload includes..."
- int8.v2: "Answer: The API returns 200 and additionally syncronizes external ledger ..." (fabricated extra sentence)

maya-ml: That matches a calibration edge-case — aggressive quantization can alter logits on low-confidence tokens in long sequences. Calibration with diverse contexts reduced that in our tests.

sam-oncall: Ops ask: can we enable fp16 fallback globally for the affected deployment group while we re-calibrate? Impact on cost?

maya-ml: Enabling fp16 fallback keeps int8 as primary but switches to fp16 for sequences/traces where quant path would cause high latency or decreased cache efficiency. Cost bump is small versus rolling back to pure fp16.

ops-bot: Rollout ticket created: ROLLBACK-9988. Action items: rollback option ready, fallback toggle available, calibration job queued.

tom-sre: I've applied a routing rule to route all 'latency-sensitive' customer keys to fp16 variant in eu-west1 and throttled int8.default.v2 to canary (10% traffic). Monitoring now.

sam-oncall: Repro steps for engineering to run locally:
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -d '{"model":"redwood-v2-13b","quant_profile":"int8.default.v2","input":"<long chat history>","max_tokens":512}'
2) Observe first_token latency and compare with fp16 profile
3) Run calibration job above and re-run step 1 with new profile

jordan: After pinning latency-sensitive keys to fp16 and throttling int8 to 10%, p99 dropped back to baseline in ~8 minutes for affected customers. We'll keep canary running and re-run calibration.

maya-ml: Longer-term fixes: better calibration coverage for long-tail prompts, add perf unit tests that run long-context traces during quant profile validation, and add automatic fp16-fallback heuristics at the worker runtime when KV cache miss rates exceed X%.

sam-oncall: Thanks — I'll update the support escalation with mitigations and closure once calibration completes and we confirm p99 stable for 24h. :thumbsup:

jordan: Thanks everyone, appreciate the rapid triage.
